statistical_unit: training seed after averaging five paired workloads; evaluation episodes and requests are not independent training replicates
information_assumption: Candidate alone observes pre-admission UE position, current request signature, and battery within 460m; physical admission remains 100m. Other methods retain existing definitions. This is a whole-system comparison, not architecture attribution.
decision_rule: Candidate minus all five learned comparators has positive mean DSR and two-sided Holm-adjusted training-seed p<0.05; report paired t and crossed-bootstrap intervals. Secondary metrics describe tradeoffs, not unqualified superiority.
